verification.note: Primary excerpt pp. 15–32 read. The official Persée rendering supplied p. 15 and its note identifying an extract from the newly published Anthropos book; a Rhuthmos mirror of the same Persée scan supplied the remaining readable OCR, https://www.rhuthmos.eu/IMG/pdf/henri_lefebvre_la_production_de_l_espace_1974.pdf. Locators: pp. 19–20 reject inventories and purely textual decoding as sufficient explanations; pp. 21–22 discuss capitalism, hegemony and space’s active role; pp. 25–27 seek the processes producing spaces and their codes. Complete French monograph and English translation body unread. Interpretations of Hegel, Marx and other writers in the excerpt remain Lefebvre’s arguments, without new person-to-person arrows.

row.context: In a read 1974 introduction excerpt, asks how social practices and power produce space rather than treating it as a passive setting or only a readable code. A specific theoretical resource beside historical reconstruction and GIS.
